review.tagline: Local MCP server that indexes code into a queryable knowledge graph
review.summary: A native C MCP server that indexes functions, classes, imports and HTTP routes across 162 languages into a local graph, and exposes 17 tools (search, trace, impact analysis, Cypher queries, dead code detection) to coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. Indexing and queries need no hosted service or API key. A browser UI, CBM Lens Beta, adds source reading, architecture maps and optional local chat, but it is only on main, not in v0.11.0.
review.audience: Developers using coding agents on large or unfamiliar codebases
strengths: Single native binary for macOS, Linux and Windows; no Docker, runtime or API key needed
162 tree-sitter grammars compiled in; hybrid LSP type resolution for 13 languages
Reports Linux kernel (28M LOC) indexed in about 3 minutes
Installer configures 45 detected agent client surfaces automatically
weaknesses: CBM Lens Beta is only on main; the current release ships the older graph UI
Token savings (120x, 10x) come from the project's own benchmarks
Preprint reports lower answer quality than file-by-file exploration (83% vs 92%)
Installer rewrites agent configs and a shared daemon requires identical builds across sessions
needs: Needs Hugging Face (optional model download for Lens chat)
